## 📐 Code Pattern (Extracted from v3.9)

```python
# SILVER LAYER TRANSFORMATION
# Generated by Legacy2Lake Architect Agent
# Source: {...}
# Primary Key(s): {...}

from config import Config
from delta.tables import *
from pyspark.sql.functions import *

# Read Bronze
df_bronze = spark.read.table(f"{Config.CATALOG}.{Config.SCHEMA_BRONZE}.{...}")

# Deduplicate
df_clean = df_bronze.dropDuplicates({...})

# SCD Type 2 Merge (Upsert)
target_table_name = f"{Config.CATALOG}.{Config.SCHEMA_SILVER}.{...}"

# Check if table exists AND we have a valid custom PK (not just default 'id')
table_exists = spark.catalog.tableExists(target_table_name)
has_custom_pk = pk_columns[0] != "id"

if table_exists and has_custom_pk:
    target_table = DeltaTable.forName(spark, target_table_name)
    target_table.alias("target").merge(
        df_clean.alias("source"),
        "{...}"
    ).whenMatchedUpdateAll().whenNotMatchedInsertAll().execute()
else:
    # First load or using default PK - use overwrite for simplicity
    df_clean.write.format("delta").mode("overwrite").saveAsTable(target_table_name)
```
